description: This file defines the JsonParsable interface, which declares methods for parsing objects of a generic type T from JSON data and headers within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.base package.

classes.name: JsonParsable
classes.description: An interface for parsing objects of type T from JSON objects and headers.

methods.name: parse(final String jsonString, final DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Default method that converts a JSON string into a JsonObject and delegates parsing to the parse method accepting a JsonObject.

methods.name: parse(JsonObject jsonObject, DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Abstract method to parse an object of type T from a JsonObject and headers.
